title: New macro names refused
summary: A macro has no scope: a new name some symbol, macro or `#ifdef` of the project already spells is refused, as is `defined`; a reserved name is done with a warning

rename.error: cannot rename `LIMIT`: `count` names `config::count` (${WS}/main.cpp:8), which the macro would replace
cannot rename `LIMIT`: `OTHER` is a macro already (${WS}/main.cpp:2)
cannot rename `LIMIT`: a directive tests `FEATURE_X` (${WS}/main.cpp:4), which the macro would define
cannot rename `LIMIT`: `defined` cannot name a macro

rename.notice:
Renaming `LIMIT`:
  `_Limit` is reserved for the implementation
